changelog: - Fix: notification e-mails sent through the router (e.g. the hand-off mail to the new rep) never left on deployments with SMTP (#3950). The mail's queue key (`notify:<ledger>`) was the `notification.email` job's own key, so `enqueue()` answered it with that job and no `email.send` row existed — the ledger said SENT, nothing was logged. The mail now has its own key (`notify-mail:<ledger>`, `src/lib/notifications/keys.ts`), and `enqueue()` refuses a key held by a job of another kind instead of returning it.

en: Fixed: e-mail notifications such as "a lead was handed to you" are delivered again.
tr: Düzeltildi: "Sana bir lead devredildi" gibi e-posta bildirimleri yeniden gönderiliyor.
de: Behoben: E-Mail-Benachrichtigungen wie „Dir wurde ein Lead übergeben“ werden wieder zugestellt.
